# SM Energy Company

## SM Energy is a premier operator of top-tier assets, delivering value through:
* Returns-Focused
* World-Class Technical Team
* Value-Driven Synergies
* Strong Balance Sheet
* High-Quality Inventory

[scroll down]

## SM Energy is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company with a long-standing,
## principled approach to doing business ethically and sustainably.

### Our Purpose

To make people’s lives better by responsibly producing energy supplies, contributing to domestic
energy security and prosperity, and having a positive impact in the communities where we live and
work.

### Our Vision

To sustainably grow value for all of our stakeholders by maintaining and optimizing our high-quality
asset portfolio, generating cash flows, and maintaining a strong balance sheet.

### Our Strategy

To be a premier operator of top-tier oil and gas assets. Our team executes this strategy by
prioritizing safety, technological innovation, and stewardship of natural resources, all of which
are integral to our corporate culture.

[ Get To Know Us ][44]

## Sustainability

Protecting the health and safety of our employees, safeguarding the environment, and giving back to
our communities shapes every decision we make.

[Learn How We Set The Bar][53]

## Careers at SM Energy

Our people are our greatest asset. At SM Energy, we provide comprehensive benefits, rewarding career
opportunities, and professional development within an engaging, values-driven culture.

[ Explore What We Offer ][54]

> "SM Energy managers wanted to get to know me as a person, not just as a worker. They wanted to
> know who I was and where I wanted to get to in my career."

Systems Analyst

> “SM Energy has an extremely collaborative work environment. Everyone is willing to help or support
> whenever it's needed. Most of our work is done in teams across multiple disciplines, and even
> geographical locations, and the end product is always high quality, because of the culture of
> collaboration and recognition.”

Reservoir Engineer

> ”SM Energy truly has something unique, the people. I cannot stress how much I enjoy working with
> my managers, my coworkers, and people from previous teams.”

Systems Analyst

> ”I would recommend SM Energy to potential employees who are self-motivated and who want to work on
> meaningful projects. As an employee at SM Energy, you will be given a high level of autonomy and
> will be given opportunities and tools to grow further in your career."

Geophysicist

> ”I choose to stay at SM because of the positive company culture. At SM Energy, I can be myself
> with no judgement and I feel valued and recognized.”

Petrophysicist

## SM Energy is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company with a long-standing,
## principled approach to doing business ethically and sustainably.

### Our Purpose

To make people’s lives better by responsibly producing energy supplies, contributing to domestic
energy security and prosperity, and having a positive impact in the communities where we live and
work.

### Our Vision

To sustainably grow value for all of our stakeholders by maintaining and optimizing our high-quality
asset portfolio, generating cash flows, and maintaining a strong balance sheet.

### Our Strategy

To be a premier operator of top-tier oil and gas assets. Our team executes this strategy by
prioritizing safety, technological innovation, and stewardship of natural resources, all of which
are integral to our corporate culture.

### **Pioneering a New Era in Fare Payments**

Masabi is leading the movement away from closed legacy fare collection systems. We’re redefining the
entire approach to fare collection with our Fare Payments-as-a-Service model, delivering agencies
the latest ticketing innovations quickly and cost-effectively, revolutionizing the passenger
experience.

## **Transform Your Transport System with Contactless Ticketing**

Elevate your transit network with Masabi’s contactless ticketing platform. Provide unparalleled
convenience while lowering fare collection costs. Our solutions ensure equity for all riders and
offer flexible payment options resulting in **increased ridership**, **reduced dwell times**, and
greener, **less congested cities**.

Integrate seamlessly with various transport modes to enable smooth, **connected journeys for all**,
fostering vibrant communities and sustainable cities. Let’s create a future where public
transportation is the first choice for everyone.

## **Enterprise-Ready**

Justride is a robust, secure, and reliable Account-Based Ticketing platform delivering Smart Card,
Open Payment (cEMV), Mobile Ticketing, Barcode and Mobility-as-a-Service solutions via a

convenience while lowering fare collection costs. Our solutions ensure equity for all riders and
offer flexible payment options resulting in **increased ridership**, **reduced dwell times**, and

The Scheidt & Bachmann Group is one of the leading providers of innovative system solutions for

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Should I use RFID, bar code or magnetic stripe card technology?

This depends on any existing or new systems you will be using along with your ID cards such as door
access systems, tracking and/or verification software, check-in/out programs, etc. CI Solutions will
find the card format that works with these systems and design an ID card that integrates RFID,
barcode, and/or magnetic stripe depending on what the card will be used for.

I need a new ID card design, can CI Solutions help me?

CI Solutions’ Graphics Team has designed cards for thousands of organizations. We can provide you
with multiple design and layout options based on your industry and brand.

What kind of card printer do I need to print my cards?

This depends on the type of card technology you are using (RFID and/or magstripe), if you are
printing on one or both sides of your cards, and if you are printing color or just black and white
text. CI Solutions offers pre-printed card stock and half-panel color ribbons to keep printing time
to a minimum as well as competitive pricing on the leading card printers in the market.

What kind of software do I need to print my cards?

Badge, our card printing software, allows you to easily print and enroll RFID cards. We will install
your card designs/layouts and train you on how to print cards.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

## Features

Works with over 1000 brands

Home Assistant integrates with over a thousand different devices and services.

Once started, Home Assistant will automatically scan your network for known devices and allow you to
easily set them up.

[EXPLORE INTEGRATIONS][48]
Powerful automations

Once you have integrated all your devices at home, you can unleash Home Assistant’s advanced
automation engine to make your home work for you.
* Turn on the light when the sun sets or when coming home
* Alert you when you leave your garage door open.

[EXPLORE AUTOMATIONS][49]
Versatile dashboards

Home Assistant dashboards allow you to display information about your smart home. Dashboards are
customizable and provide a powerful way to manage your home from your mobile or desktop.
* Easily create and customize your dashboards with drag-and-drop.
* Different card types to visualize your data and control your smart home devices.

[EXPLORE DASHBOARDS][50]
Assist, our voice assistant

Assist allows you to control Home Assistant using natural language. It is built on top of an open
voice foundation and powered by knowledge provided by our community.
* Customize your voice assistant and experiment with AI conversations.
* Use Assist everywhere on your mobile phone, tablets, smartwatches, and even old-school telephones.

[EXPLORE ASSIST][51]
Extend your system with apps

Home Assistant is not just limited to Home Assistant. Easily install other applications that will
help you manage your home.
* Run AdGuard, a DNS-based ad blocker
* Run third party automation engines like NodeRed
* Turn Home Assistant into a Spotify Connect target

[Explore apps for Home Assistant][52]
All your smart home data stays local

Home Assistant keeps your data local, no need for a cloud.

Home Assistant communicates with your devices locally, and will fallback to pulling in data from the
cloud if there is no other option. No data is stored in the cloud, and everything is processed
locally.

## Features

Works with over 1000 brands

Home Assistant integrates with over a thousand different devices and services.

Once started, Home Assistant will automatically scan your network for known devices and allow you to
easily set them up.

[EXPLORE INTEGRATIONS][48]
Powerful automations

Once you have integrated all your devices at home, you can unleash Home Assistant’s advanced
automation engine to make your home work for you.
* Turn on the light when the sun sets or when coming home
* Alert you when you leave your garage door open.

[EXPLORE AUTOMATIONS][49]
Versatile dashboards

Home Assistant dashboards allow you to display information about your smart home. Dashboards are
customizable and provide a powerful way to manage your home from your mobile or desktop.
* Easily create and customize your dashboards with drag-and-drop.
* Different card types to visualize your data and control your smart home devices.

[EXPLORE DASHBOARDS][50]
Assist, our voice assistant

Assist allows you to control Home Assistant using natural language. It is built on top of an open
voice foundation and powered by knowledge provided by our community.
* Customize your voice assistant and experiment with AI conversations.
* Use Assist everywhere on your mobile phone, tablets, smartwatches, and even old-school telephones.

[EXPLORE ASSIST][51]
Extend your system with apps

Home Assistant is not just limited to Home Assistant. Easily install other applications that will
help you manage your home.
* Run AdGuard, a DNS-based ad blocker
* Run third party automation engines like NodeRed
* Turn Home Assistant into a Spotify Connect target

[Explore apps for Home Assistant][52]
All your smart home data stays local

Home Assistant keeps your data local, no need for a cloud.

Home Assistant communicates with your devices locally, and will fallback to pulling in data from the
cloud if there is no other option. No data is stored in the cloud, and everything is processed
locally.

Companion Mobile Apps

Use the official Home Assistant apps, a convenient companion to quickly control your devices and be
notified when things happen in your home, even on your wrist using the Apple Watch.

The apps can also be used to send your location home to use presence detection as part of your
automations. Data is sent directly to your home, no access by third-parties.

development of a new 200 megawatt electrolysis-based hydrogen plant. Once complete, the project will

directly supports Worley's purpose statement of delivering a more sustainable world. Shell’s Holland
Hydrogen I project will be located on the Tweede Maasvlakte in the Port of Rotterdam in the
Netherlands. A final investment decision will be made later this year.

### Siemens: Cooperation on use of LOHC tech in rail transport planned

Siemens Mobility and the Helmholtz Institute Erlangen-Nuremberg for Renewable Energy agree on joint
research for the use of Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carrier (LOHC) technology in rail transport - The
use of hydrogen technology in rail transport is becoming increasingly important as a solution for
reducing CO2 emissions and helping to meet climate targets. In recent years, Siemens Mobility has
developed a hydrogen-powered train, the Mireo Plus H. In this technology, hydrogen is tanked in gas
form and must be kept under high pressure in order to achieve the required high density.

##### MJ Holding Company, LLC is the largest North American distributor of trading cards (including
##### gaming, sports, and entertainment), related trading card supplies, collectibles, toys, and hot
##### trend items. We provide retail supply chain management and specialize in category planning,
##### planogram development, initial distribution, replenishment, and merchandising of the modular
##### for our retail partners. Additionally, we support manufacturers who are looking for retail
##### distribution of their products.

We’ve been in the trading card distribution business since 1993. Over the years, we developed an
effective category management process that helped grow our retail distribution footprint across all
of the United States and Canada. Our expansion has seen the acquisition of 5 companies since 2000,
and partnerships with the strongest retail stores and biggest brands in the game.

Headquartered in Bridgeview, Illinois, just outside of Chicago, MJ Holding operates out of a 300K
sq. foot distribution center and corporate offices. Additionally, we have a 30K sq. foot
distribution center in Cambridge, Ontario to support our Canadian customers. MJ Holding provides our
services to over 7,000 retail store locations across the United States and Canada.

[Learn more about MJ Holding][6]

### **MJ Holding Services**

MJ Holding provides retail supply chain management and specialize in category planning, planogram
development, initial distribution, replenishment, and merchandising of the modular. We continue to
work with our manufacturing partners to secure merchandising space in stores of our mass retail
partners.

## Q&A

Everything you need to know about using Moovit
* ### How do I search for a specific bus or train line in the app?
  
  To find a specific transit line, tap on the 'Lines' tab located at the bottom of the Moovit app's
  main screen. You can then use the search bar to enter the bus, train, or subway line number or
  name. Moovit will display the line's route, schedule, and real-time arrival information.
* ### How do I plan a trip using public transit in the app?
  
  To plan a trip, open the Moovit app and enter your destination in the 'Where to?' search bar. The
  app will show you several route options using local public transit like buses, trains, or subways.
  You can review the suggested routes, which include travel times and step-by-step directions, to
  choose the one that works for you.
* ### How do I check the bus schedule for my line?
  
  You can find the schedule for any transit line in the Moovit app by searching for the line number
  or tapping on a station. From there, you can see upcoming arrival times and select the option to
  view the full timetable. This allows you to check the bus schedule, train times, and more.

a local. Get the best routes to major attractions, streets and stations with step by step
directions, detailed schedules, maps and more. Moovit shows you the simplest way to travel by train,
bus, tram or subway!

### Популярные направления из Санкт-Петербурга

[

##### Сиде

Курорт Турции
Сиде привлекает своими теплыми песчаными пляжами и хорошо сохранившимся сооружениями античного
города
][47]
[

##### Паттайя

Курорт Таиланда
Паттайя - самый большой курорт Таиланда. Обычно Патайю выбирают, если хотят совместить пляжный отдых
с экскурсионкой - отсюда ближе чем от других курортов река Квай, Камбоджа, Ко-Чанг, Бангкок и
Аютайя. В Паттайе отличные сети массажных салонов, много различных шоу, тропический сад Нонг Нуч с
его вечерним представлением - скучать не придется.
][48]
[

##### Эль-Гуна

Курорт Египта
Курорт на изолированной территории, здесь много отелей достаточно высокого уровня. Курорт -
множество островов, разделенных каналами, острова соединены мостиками. Курорт для тихого
респектабельного отдыха.
][49]
[

##### Анталья

Курорт Турции
Отдых в Антальи - выбор многих жителей Санкт-Петербурга. Поможем подобрать лучший отель по вашим
потребностям, и выбрать оптимальный тур в Анталию из СПб.
][50]
[

##### Марса Алам

Курорт Египта
Марса Алам - располагается на самом юге Египта, славится своими кораллами и морскими обитателями,
здесь можно увидеть дюгоней, морских черепах и гигантских скатов. Есть свой международный аэропорт,
но из России обычно летят в Хургаду.
][51]
[

##### Сафага

Курорт Египта
Сафага располагается в 60 км южнее Хургады, курорт предлагает отдых как для любителей виндсерфинга,
так и обычных пляжников - неплохие кораллы, кроме того в Сафаге проходят оздоровление при псориазе и
артритах.
][52]
[

##### Ко Чанг

Курорт Таиланда
Ко Чанг - остров с отличными пляжами и коралловым песком. Здесь нет водных мотоциклов и шума толпы,
территория Ко Чанга входит в Морской Национальный Парк. Есть отели, где можно уединиться большой
компанией. На близлежащих островах есть места для дайвинга и снорклинга - прозрачная вода,
коралловый песок и много морской живности.
][53]
[

##### Бангкок

Курорт Таиланда
Столица Таиланда известна своими дворцами и храмами, и в то же время это современный город с
огромными торговыми центрами и современными отелями. Здесь разветвленная сеть каналов, по которым
снует множество лодок - популярны круизы. Тем кто хочет увидеть Бангок с высоты птичьего полета
советуем заказать ужин в ресторане отеля Байок Скай - здание высотой 305 метров.
][54]
[

##### Хургада

Курорт Египта
Хургада - один из первых курортов Египта, аэропорт близко от отелей, пляжи засыпанные песком,
подойдет для отдыха с детьми, не забывайте о коралловых тапочках. На курорте есть отели с
аквапарками и неплохим сервисом.
][55]
[

##### Макади Бэй

Курорт Египта
Макади Бэй - курорт южнее Хургады, здесь расположено много гостиниц высокого уровня, отличные
кораллы и сравнительно близко от аэропорта.
][56]
[

##### Шарм-эль-Шейх

Курорт Египта
Шарм-эль-Шейх курорт с самыми красивыми коралловыми рифами. Здесь отели достаточно высокого
качества, много торговых центров и развлечений как в самих отелях, так в центрах курортной жизни в
Наама-Бей и Сохо.
][57]
[

##### Пхи-Пхи

Курорт Таиланда
Острова Пхи-Пхи расположены равноудаленно от Краби и Пхукета. Здесь прекрасные виды, отличное
Андаманское море, но стоит помнить, что туристов здесь днем просто огромное количество. Обитаемый
остров - Пхи-Пхи Дон, здесь расположены отели с ресторанами, барами и дискотеками. На остров Пхи-Пхи
Лей приезжают посмотреть на чистые и красивые пляжики, окруженные скалами. Из достопримечательностей

## Частые вопросы

Каким образом происходит вычет НДС?
1. Вы получаете от нас отчетные документы, в которых итоговая сумма включает НДС 22%.
2. Ваша бухгалтерия подает заявление в налоговую инспекцию о возврате суммы, которая указана в наших
   документах.
3. Налоговая инспекция принимает заявление, производит проверку предоставленных вами документов.
4. Если все верно, то налоговая инспекция уменьшает ваши налоговые платежи.

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to
find out how many SIM cards are linked to their identity using their Aadhaar or mobile number.

Here’s how you can use the TAFCOP portal for Aadhaar card mobile number check:
1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

## **Sanchar Saathi App – Download and Features**

The Sanchar Saathi App, available on the Google Play Store, provides all major features of the
portal in one mobile application.

### **How to Download the Sanchar Saathi App**
1. Open the Play Store on your Android phone
2. Search for “[**Sanchar Saathi App**][29]”
3. Tap Install and open the app after downloading
4. Register using your mobile number and verify via OTP

The app offers a simple dashboard that lets users access CEIR, TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi, and KYM
features in one place. It is expected to come pre-installed on all new smartphones as per DoT’s 2025
guidelines.

**Note**: The Government of India has made it mandatory for all new smartphones to come with the
[**Sanchar Saathi app**][30] pre-installed, ensuring users stay protected from SIM misuse and mobile
fraud.

### **Key Features of the Sanchar Saathi App**
* Check all mobile numbers linked to your identity
* Verify if a mobile device is genuine using its IMEI number
* Block or unblock lost and recovered phones
* Report fraud calls, scam messages, or fake customer-care numbers
* View official and trusted helpline numbers of banks and telecom operators

The app also integrates with a new DoT service called Chakshu, which allows users to report
suspicious communication such as phishing messages or fake financial service calls.

include:
* Easy access to all active SIMs under your name
* Option to report and block unknown or inactive numbers
* SMS alerts when a new SIM is issued under your identity
* A complaint tracking system to follow up on fraud reports

The TAFCOP mobile number check feature ensures no one misuses your identity to obtain extra SIM
cards without consent.

planning. All Metro Vancouver riders now get free access to Royale, Transit’s premium subscription,
courtesy of TransLink!

### Detours Near Broadway–City Hall Station

Travellers passing through the Broadway–City Hall area can expect traffic changes and some relocated
bus stops as construction for the Broadway Subway continues.

## What's New at TransLink

### Expo Line Weekend Service Impacts

[SkyTrain travelling through Dunsmuir tunnel with track in foreground]

Weekend service on the Expo Line will have early morning and late evening disruptions between
Waterfront and Commercial–Broadway stations until fall. Riders should plan for up to 20 extra
minutes travel time.

[See service impacts][25]

### R2 Marine-Willingdon RapidBus Construction Impacts

[RapidBus on Marine Drive surrounded by moving traffic]

R2 Marine–Willingdon RapidBus construction is underway. Travellers along this route can expect
temporary bus stop changes and traffic impacts.

[See project details][26]

### Burrard Station Elevators Out of Service

# Public Transit 

Have you ever been confused by public transportation in a new city? We have. How do you buy a
ticket? Did you buy the right ticket? How do you board and exit the subway or bus? What do you need
to transfer? These are the types of questions we answer at Tunnel Time.

Our goal is to provide you with all the details you need to make your travel easy.

# Ride Sharing Apps

Ride sharing apps are often one of the best ways to get around in a new city. What if the apps you
are used to aren’t available in your new city? We’ll show you all ride sharing options, each vehicle
type they have available and their best features.

# Bike and Scooter Share

Many cities have bicycle rental options to get around the town on the cheap. We’re also starting to
see electric pedal assist bikes and electric scooters show up in many major locations. While riding
a bike may be the same world wide, reserving, unlocking, and locking-up can change from city to
city. Don’t worry, we’ve got you covered.

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Should I use RFID, bar code or magnetic stripe card technology?

This depends on any existing or new systems you will be using along with your ID cards such as door
access systems, tracking and/or verification software, check-in/out programs, etc. CI Solutions will
find the card format that works with these systems and design an ID card that integrates RFID,
barcode, and/or magnetic stripe depending on what the card will be used for.

I need a new ID card design, can CI Solutions help me?

CI Solutions’ Graphics Team has designed cards for thousands of organizations. We can provide you
with multiple design and layout options based on your industry and brand.

What kind of card printer do I need to print my cards?

This depends on the type of card technology you are using (RFID and/or magstripe), if you are
printing on one or both sides of your cards, and if you are printing color or just black and white
text. CI Solutions offers pre-printed card stock and half-panel color ribbons to keep printing time
to a minimum as well as competitive pricing on the leading card printers in the market.

What kind of software do I need to print my cards?

Badge, our card printing software, allows you to easily print and enroll RFID cards. We will install
your card designs/layouts and train you on how to print cards.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

details they need, all in one convenient place.

## Features

Works with over 1000 brands

Home Assistant integrates with over a thousand different devices and services.

Once started, Home Assistant will automatically scan your network for known devices and allow you to
easily set them up.

[EXPLORE INTEGRATIONS][48]
Powerful automations

Once you have integrated all your devices at home, you can unleash Home Assistant’s advanced
automation engine to make your home work for you.
* Turn on the light when the sun sets or when coming home
* Alert you when you leave your garage door open.

[EXPLORE AUTOMATIONS][49]
Versatile dashboards

Home Assistant dashboards allow you to display information about your smart home. Dashboards are
customizable and provide a powerful way to manage your home from your mobile or desktop.
* Easily create and customize your dashboards with drag-and-drop.
* Different card types to visualize your data and control your smart home devices.

[EXPLORE DASHBOARDS][50]
Assist, our voice assistant

Assist allows you to control Home Assistant using natural language. It is built on top of an open
voice foundation and powered by knowledge provided by our community.
* Customize your voice assistant and experiment with AI conversations.
* Use Assist everywhere on your mobile phone, tablets, smartwatches, and even old-school telephones.

[EXPLORE ASSIST][51]
Extend your system with apps

Home Assistant is not just limited to Home Assistant. Easily install other applications that will
help you manage your home.
* Run AdGuard, a DNS-based ad blocker
* Run third party automation engines like NodeRed
* Turn Home Assistant into a Spotify Connect target

[Explore apps for Home Assistant][52]
All your smart home data stays local

Home Assistant keeps your data local, no need for a cloud.

Home Assistant communicates with your devices locally, and will fallback to pulling in data from the
cloud if there is no other option. No data is stored in the cloud, and everything is processed
locally.

Worley has been been awarded an early engineering services contract by Shell to support the

be one of the largest commercial green hydrogen production facilities in the world. The project
directly supports Worley's purpose statement of delivering a more sustainable world. Shell’s Holland
Hydrogen I project will be located on the Tweede Maasvlakte in the Port of Rotterdam in the
Netherlands. A final investment decision will be made later this year.

### Shell awards Worley contract to help create a green hydrogen factory

Worley has been been awarded an early engineering services contract by Shell to support the
development of a new 200 megawatt electrolysis-based hydrogen plant. Once complete, the project will
be one of the largest commercial green hydrogen production facilities in the world. The project
directly supports Worley's purpose statement of delivering a more sustainable world. Shell’s Holland
Hydrogen I project will be located on the Tweede Maasvlakte in the Port of Rotterdam in the
Netherlands. A final investment decision will be made later this year.

### US Transport Secretary: $2.5B for Public Transit Services Nationally

U.S. Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg announced the recommendation of $2.5 billion to advance
the construction or completion of 25 rail, bus rapid transit (BRT) and streetcar projects in 12
states, as well as other projects that may become ready for funding in Fiscal Year (FY) 2022. These
projects, competitively funded through the Federal Transit Administration’s (FTA) Capital Investment
Grants (CIG) Program, will create hundreds of construction and operations-related jobs and help
communities expand transportation options that improve access and mobility for residents.

### Siemens: Cooperation on use of LOHC tech in rail transport planned

Siemens Mobility and the Helmholtz Institute Erlangen-Nuremberg for Renewable Energy agree on joint
research for the use of Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carrier (LOHC) technology in rail transport - The
use of hydrogen technology in rail transport is becoming increasingly important as a solution for
reducing CO2 emissions and helping to meet climate targets. In recent years, Siemens Mobility has
developed a hydrogen-powered train, the Mireo Plus H. In this technology, hydrogen is tanked in gas
form and must be kept under high pressure in order to achieve the required high density.

  To find a specific transit line, tap on the 'Lines' tab located at the bottom of the Moovit app's
  main screen. You can then use the search bar to enter the bus, train, or subway line number or
  name. Moovit will display the line's route, schedule, and real-time arrival information.
* ### How do I plan a trip using public transit in the app?
  
  To plan a trip, open the Moovit app and enter your destination in the 'Where to?' search bar. The
  app will show you several route options using local public transit like buses, trains, or subways.
  You can review the suggested routes, which include travel times and step-by-step directions, to
  choose the one that works for you.
* ### How do I check the bus schedule for my line?
  
  You can find the schedule for any transit line in the Moovit app by searching for the line number
  or tapping on a station. From there, you can see upcoming arrival times and select the option to
  view the full timetable. This allows you to check the bus schedule, train times, and more.

## Частые вопросы

Каким образом происходит вычет НДС?
1. Вы получаете от нас отчетные документы, в которых итоговая сумма включает НДС 22%.
2. Ваша бухгалтерия подает заявление в налоговую инспекцию о возврате суммы, которая указана в наших
   документах.
3. Налоговая инспекция принимает заявление, производит проверку предоставленных вами документов.
4. Если все верно, то налоговая инспекция уменьшает ваши налоговые платежи.

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to

1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

## **Sanchar Saathi App – Download and Features**

The Sanchar Saathi App, available on the Google Play Store, provides all major features of the
portal in one mobile application.

### **How to Download the Sanchar Saathi App**
1. Open the Play Store on your Android phone
2. Search for “[**Sanchar Saathi App**][29]”
3. Tap Install and open the app after downloading
4. Register using your mobile number and verify via OTP

The app offers a simple dashboard that lets users access CEIR, TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi, and KYM
features in one place. It is expected to come pre-installed on all new smartphones as per DoT’s 2025
guidelines.

**Note**: The Government of India has made it mandatory for all new smartphones to come with the
[**Sanchar Saathi app**][30] pre-installed, ensuring users stay protected from SIM misuse and mobile
fraud.

### **Key Features of the Sanchar Saathi App**
* Check all mobile numbers linked to your identity

* Block or unblock lost and recovered phones
* Report fraud calls, scam messages, or fake customer-care numbers
* View official and trusted helpline numbers of banks and telecom operators

The app also integrates with a new DoT service called Chakshu, which allows users to report
suspicious communication such as phishing messages or fake financial service calls.

## **TAFCOP Consumer Portal – Benefits for Users**

The TAFCOP Consumer Portal helps users monitor and secure their telecom accounts. Some key benefits
include:
* Easy access to all active SIMs under your name

* SMS alerts when a new SIM is issued under your identity
* A complaint tracking system to follow up on fraud reports

The TAFCOP mobile number check feature ensures no one misuses your identity to obtain extra SIM
cards without consent.

planning. All Metro Vancouver riders now get free access to Royale, Transit’s premium subscription,

minutes travel time.

are available.

# Public Transit 

Have you ever been confused by public transportation in a new city? We have. How do you buy a
ticket? Did you buy the right ticket? How do you board and exit the subway or bus? What do you need
to transfer? These are the types of questions we answer at Tunnel Time.

Our goal is to provide you with all the details you need to make your travel easy.

# Ride Sharing Apps

Ride sharing apps are often one of the best ways to get around in a new city. What if the apps you
are used to aren’t available in your new city? We’ll show you all ride sharing options, each vehicle
type they have available and their best features.

# Bike and Scooter Share

Many cities have bicycle rental options to get around the town on the cheap. We’re also starting to
see electric pedal assist bikes and electric scooters show up in many major locations. While riding
a bike may be the same world wide, reserving, unlocking, and locking-up can change from city to
city. Don’t worry, we’ve got you covered.
